RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

The composition of the panel alone is not evidence of bias. Interview panels are routinely formed based on availability, grade, and relevant department roles; an all-female panel falls well within normal administrative variation. Additionally, the appointed candidate possesses relevant postgraduate qualifications and specific project leadership experience.

Raising an allegation of discrimination based solely on the panel’s gender is unsubstantiated and could damage your professional standing within the civil service. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting your interview scores and constructive feedback. Only reconsider your position if written feedback reveals clear procedural flaws or objective irregularities in how candidates were evaluated against the job specification.
